content:
maria: Heads-up — in prod we have sampled decision logs showing route matched but header overrides appear missing when KV prefetch hits. Repro steps below.

oliver: Hmm, can you paste the raw decision trace?

maria: pasted...
```
ROUTE_EVAL: route_id=ingress.chat.v1 matched=true
MATCH_RULES: header.user-tier not present
OVERRIDE_APPLIED: false
SAMPLER_ID: prefetched-kw-42
```

sam: prefetched-kw-42 means the sampler used cached keys, right? could be skipping header normalization

lee: Any recent changes to sampler hashing? I thought we rolled the header-normalize patch last week.

maria: We did. Canary shows normalizing on cold evals but not on sampled prefetch paths. Seen at 3 AZs.

maya: query: how many samples are affected? dashboard shows a bump in sampling mismatches around 2026-02-12 03:10 UTC

maria: Rough numbers: ~0.6% of sampled decisions in last 24h, but 95% are from endpoints behind prefetched cache.

oliver: Can you run the local repro? `curl -H \"X-User-Tier: premium\" https://gateway.local/eval?trace=1` and compare with `curl` without header.

maria: I ran that — when sampler path hits, header isn't included in the generated decision hash so override doesn't fire. Logs:
```
INCOMING: headers = {x-user-tier: premium}
SAMPLER_PATH: true
COMPUTED_HASH: 0x8f3a
NORMALIZED_HEADERS: {}
```

sam: That indicates header normalization been skipped earlier in the pipeline. Where is the sampler invoked relative to header parsing?

lee: Sampler lives in front of the router to reduce eval cost — it should still receive normalized context. Maybe an optimization removed copy.

maya: FYI trace-bot attached traces: https://internal.traces/replay/abc123 :eyes: 

oliver: Ok plan: 1) Add temporary debug flag to force full context copy into sampler for a minute, 2) run 50k requests from synthetic runner, 3) compare decision hash distribution.

maria: I've added `platform.sampler.force_full_ctx=true` to prod-config for eng-sandbox and started the runner.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: config/patch platform.sampler.force_full_ctx=true -> env=eng-sandbox, rollout=1/1

maya: Results: delta dropped to 0.01% in eng-sandbox. So bug confirmed.

sam: Likely root cause: `Context::shallowView()` used instead of `Context::normalized()` when prefetch cache hit. Patch candidate incoming.

oliver: Can you open a PR with tests that assert override behavior when sampler cache hits? Add an integration test that hits prefetched path.

maria: PR: https://git/repo/pull/7845 — includes unit+integration, and a migration to include header normalization in `Sampler::prefetch`.

lee: Runbook: after PR merges, canary to 10% of edge nodes for 2 hours, then 50%, then full. Also add a metric `sampler.header_mismatch_count` and an alert if >0.1%.

maya: I'll add dashboard tiles to RouteEval -> Sampling showing mismatch rate and sampler hash entropy.

oliver: Great. One more: let's backport to the 2.7.x stable branch for Dedicated customers running older runtime.

maria: Will do. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:

sam: Nice find! :tada:

trace-bot: trace attached to PR for replay: https://internal.traces/replay/pr/7845
